in_hebrew.name: Gamin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gamin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'agamemnon', meaning 'without sorrow'. In the New Testament, the name Gamaliel is mentioned, meaning 'reward of God'. The name Gamin can be interpreted as a young, cheerful, and loyal goat or the reward of God.
